user_request: GH에게 전달해서 SH4에서 batch 1개만 test 해보는 것으로 해서 실현률이 올라갔는지부터 테스트 하는 것으로 하자
precedence: This explicit user scope overrides experiment.json owner SH3/server3, Q1 BS2x2, and MAIN_2K automatic continuation. Method is unchanged. Only one first100 logical batch is authorized; no B2 or 2k submission.

workload.profile: v12 Llama3-8B-Instruct / CounterFact, same ordered first100, all L4-L8
workload.fit: unchanged v12 planner, shared budget .75, EfficiencyAdam, native lambda/context, max25 evaluations/24 updates

writer_branches.writer: equality/range-LS all native injected subject rows
writer_branches.target: repeat owner D, including KL rows

workload.entry_restore: RAM restore exact W/H/RNG for each branch; fresh own actual upper K/h after lower writes; do not share keys between branches
workload.history: all eligible layers, final rewrite-only native nested mean keys, once per branch, then restore
workload.stop: after B1 measurements/report. No automatic B2, 500, or 2000 edits; no coefficient search or new baseline fit

implementation.status: CPU reference only; SH4 implements production integration
implementation.shared_code_policy: prefer new namespace and read-only reuse; necessary shared adapter changes must be minimal, recorded, and covered by parity checks
implementation.branch: dedicated codex/ non-main worktree; preserve other agents' changes
implementation.generic: model/benchmark/logical batch are profile settings; q_r and dimensions derived; no hardcoded six/seven rows in writer

qualification.cpu: run same reference16 tests and meaningful implementation tests
qualification.actual: Before B1 branch commits, validate row/site mapping, numerical projection and FP32 actual action/restore on B1 inputs. Any subset operator check is within B1 and restored; no separate BS2x2 sequential pilot or extra fit
qualification.technical_failures: rollback and report non-SPD/nonfinite/projection identity/cast-orientation/local parity/restore/history errors; no silent jitter, target scaling, ridge fallback or threshold tuning
qualification.science: rank deficiency alone, finite high energy or poor PS/NS are observations, not technical rejection or layer pruning

primary: per-layer mean/canonical/native rewrite/KL actual realization directional ratio, norm ratio, cosine and relative error
planned versus actual direct-action share L1
ideal FP64 versus cast versus effective FP32 versus actual subject action
inherited prestate gap separate from local writer error
zero-target leakage, rank/cutoff, incompatible target residual, Q and update norm
performance: same B1 W0/post RS100/PS200/NS1000 preference denominators
R/P desired-new and N desired-true TF strict ACC plus token/prompt ACC
NLL/margins, paired lost/gained, no evaluation-driven selection
measurements.reduction: paired per-request/per-context comparisons with denominators; do not call norm ratio near1 exact without direction/error; report undefined zero-target ratio separately
measurements.timing: fit, capture, solve, commit/history, eval, peak VRAM, total; no speed claim without measurement
measurements.success_interpretation: First establish whether actual realization improved relative to same-plan ridge, then assess allocation and PS/NS/ACC. B1 cannot establish long-term retention.

execution_envelope.slurm_submission: allowed for this bounded B1 task after technical/resource preflight; no repeat user approval needed
execution_envelope.gpu_cap: one task GPU at a time and the stricter active server/project GPU and CPU-memory cap; inspect current caps and scheduler, do not cancel existing jobs
execution_envelope.publication: GH verifies and promotes design/command; SH4 reports implementation commit and exact inputs/runtime hashes. No overwrite of unrelated work.
execution_envelope.artifact_broadcast: Follow existing approved artifact broadcast script/policy for small report/telemetry/raw evaluations; record reason if impossible. No persistent model checkpoint or new large transfer is requested.
execution_envelope.audit: preflight source/config/input/numerical parity/resource boundary; postrun denominator/finiteness/rollback/history/nonmutation audit. Scientific warn can proceed; technical block stops invalid commit.

requested_ack: GH acknowledge instruction nonce, dispatch to exact SH4 session, collect SH4 acceptance or concrete blocker. Report delivery/acceptance/implementation/GPU submission separately. No claim of running before job evidence.
